bedroom.caption: BEDROOM
bedroom.alt: 固定星星房間中的折疊尺

stream.caption: STREAM

pages.title: A folding ruler
lines: A ruler unfolds.
pages.translation: 尺子展開了。

pages.title: Across the room
lines: Gail sees a stream.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看見小溪。

pages.title: The unfinished bridge
lines: The bridge is not done.
pages.translation: 橋還沒搭好。

pages.title: A visible gap
lines: The plank is too short.
pages.translation: 木板太短了。

pages.title: Stay on shore
lines: Gail stays back.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜留在岸邊。

pages.title: Measure the span
lines: How wide is the stream?
pages.translation: 小溪有多寬？

pages.title: Measure the plank
lines: How long is the plank?
pages.translation: 木板有多長？

pages.title: Two lengths
lines: The lengths do not match.
pages.translation: 兩個長度不同。

pages.title: Try a model
lines: Let's make a model.
pages.translation: 來做模型吧。

pages.title: A bending plank
lines: This plank bends.
pages.translation: 這塊板彎了。

pages.title: Add a support
lines: A support helps.
pages.translation: 支柱有幫助。

pages.title: Look at an arch
lines: An arch helps too.
pages.translation: 橋拱也有幫助。

pages.title: Check each joint
lines: Check this join.
pages.translation: 檢查這個接點。

pages.title: Choose a plan
lines: They have a plan.
pages.translation: 他們有計畫了。

pages.title: Bring the right plank
lines: This plank can reach.
pages.translation: 這塊板跨得過去。

pages.title: Build the platform
lines: Adults build the bridge.
pages.translation: 大人搭橋。

pages.title: Test it first
lines: The builder tests it.
pages.translation: 工匠先測試。

pages.title: Walk across
lines: They cross the bridge.
pages.translation: 他們過橋了。

pages.title: The ruler glows
lines: Time to go home.
pages.translation: 該回家了。

pages.title: Back in the bedroom
lines: Gail is home.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜回家了。

pages.title: A folding ruler
lines: A folding ruler glows on Gail's floor. It opens like a little door.
pages.translation: 折疊尺在瑜瑜的地板上發光，像小門一樣打開。

pages.title: Across the room
lines: The ruler's light stretches across the room. Gail sees a stream through it.
pages.translation: 尺子的光穿過房間。瑜瑜從中看見小溪。

pages.title: The unfinished bridge
lines: Gail meets the builder by a small stream. The bridge is not ready to cross.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜在小溪旁遇見工匠。橋還不能走。

pages.title: A visible gap
lines: One plank ends before the other bank. A gap is easy to see.
pages.translation: 一塊木板到不了對岸，缺口很清楚。

pages.title: Stay on shore
lines: Gail and her friends stay in the safe area. The builders stop work to check.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜與朋友待在安全區。工匠停下來檢查。

pages.title: Measure the span
lines: The builder measures between the two supports. Gail watches the number on the ruler.
pages.translation: 工匠量兩個支座之間的距離。瑜瑜看著尺子。

pages.title: Measure the plank
lines: They measure the plank too. It is shorter than the space it must cross.
pages.translation: 他們也量木板。它比需要跨越的距離短。

pages.title: Two lengths
lines: Gail puts two colored strips side by side. One is shorter.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把兩條彩帶並排。一條比較短。

pages.title: Try a model
lines: The builder gives Gail a little bridge model. They can test ideas on the table.
pages.translation: 工匠給瑜瑜一個小橋模型。他們能在桌上試想法。

pages.title: A bending plank
lines: A thin model plank bends under a small weight. Gail sees it needs support.
pages.translation: 薄模型木板在小重物下彎曲。瑜瑜看見它需要支撐。

pages.title: Add a support
lines: They put a support under the model. The plank bends less.
pages.translation: 他們在模型下加支柱，木板彎得比較少。

pages.title: Look at an arch
lines: The model has an arch. Gail sees how its shape holds the top.
pages.translation: 模型有橋拱。瑜瑜看見這個形狀如何撐住上方。

pages.title: Check each joint
lines: Gail points to a loose joint on the model. The builder connects it again.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜指出模型鬆開的接點。工匠把它重新接好。

pages.title: Choose a plan
lines: The builders choose a longer plank and strong supports. Gail shows them the model.
pages.translation: 工匠選擇較長木板與穩固支柱。瑜瑜展示模型。

pages.title: Bring the right plank
lines: Adults bring a plank that reaches both supports. Gail stays back.
pages.translation: 大人搬來能跨到兩側支座的木板。瑜瑜留在後方。

pages.title: Build the platform
lines: The builders fix the platform and bolts. Children wait behind the line.
pages.translation: 工匠固定橋面與螺栓。孩子們在線後等待。

pages.title: Test it first
lines: An adult checks the level and steps on the bridge first. It feels steady.
pages.translation: 大人檢查水平並先走上橋，橋很穩。

pages.title: Walk across
lines: The builder says the bridge is ready. Gail crosses with an adult.
pages.translation: 工匠說橋可以走了。瑜瑜和大人一起過橋。

pages.title: The ruler glows
lines: The builder thanks Gail for comparing the lengths. Her ruler glows again.
pages.translation: 工匠謝謝瑜瑜比較長度。她的尺又發光了。

pages.title: Back in the bedroom
lines: Gail folds the ruler by her bed. She remembers to measure before building.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把尺放在床邊。她記得搭建前先測量。

pages.title: A folding ruler
lines: In Gail's familiar bedroom, a folding ruler begins to glow. Its sections unfold slowly and make a bright outline on the floor.
pages.translation: 在瑜瑜熟悉的臥室，一把折疊尺開始發光。尺節慢慢展開，在地板上畫出亮亮的輪廓。

pages.title: Across the room
lines: Light travels from the ruler across the bedroom floor before a doorway opens. Gail sees a shallow stream and an unfinished bridge beyond it.
pages.translation: 光從尺子沿著臥室地板延伸，接著才打開入口。瑜瑜看見一條淺溪和一座搭建中的橋。

pages.title: The unfinished bridge
lines: At the stream, Gail meets an adult builder beside an unfinished footbridge. Everyone waits on the shore because the crossing is not ready.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜在小溪旁遇見一位成年工匠。行人橋還沒完工，大家都留在岸邊等待。

pages.title: A visible gap
lines: A wooden plank stops before it reaches the support on the far bank. The visible gap shows why no one should step onto the bridge yet.
pages.translation: 一塊木板還沒碰到對岸支座就停住了。明顯的缺口讓大家知道目前不能上橋。

pages.title: Stay on shore
lines: Gail stays with the other children behind the marked work area. The builders pause instead of trying to cover the gap by guesswork.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜和其他孩子待在標示的工作區外。工匠暫停施工，沒有憑猜測掩蓋缺口。

pages.title: Measure the span
lines: The builder stretches a tape between the two bridge supports and measures the full span. Gail watches where the tape begins and ends.
pages.translation: 工匠把量尺拉到橋的兩個支座之間，量出完整跨距。瑜瑜觀察尺子從哪裡開始、在哪裡結束。

pages.title: Measure the plank
lines: They then measure the plank from one end to the other. Its length is shorter than the distance between the supports, confirming the problem.
pages.translation: 接著他們量木板從一端到另一端的長度。木板短於兩個支座之間的距離，問題因此確定。

pages.title: Two lengths
lines: Gail uses colored strips on a table to compare the measured span and plank length. Their ends do not line up, so the difference is easy to see.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜在桌上用兩條彩帶比較量得的跨距與木板長度。兩端沒有對齊，差距很清楚。

pages.title: Try a model
lines: The builder brings a small bridge model to the worktable. Testing a model lets Gail see possible changes without touching the real construction.
pages.translation: 工匠拿來一個小橋模型。先測試模型，瑜瑜就能看見不同改法，而不用碰真正的工地。

pages.title: A bending plank
lines: When they set a small weight at the center, the thin model plank bends. Gail sees that reaching across is only one part of making a sturdy bridge.
pages.translation: 他們把小重物放在中央時，薄薄的模型木板彎了。瑜瑜發現，跨得過去只是穩固橋梁的一部分。

pages.title: Add a support
lines: Gail adds a support beneath the model's center while the builder watches. With the same weight, the plank bends less than before.
pages.translation: 工匠在旁看著，瑜瑜在模型中央下方加上支柱。同樣的重量放上去，木板比剛才彎得少。

pages.title: Look at an arch
lines: The builder shows how a small arch can carry weight toward both sides of the model base. Gail compares this shape with the straight plank they first tested.
pages.translation: 工匠示範小橋拱如何把重量帶向模型底座兩端。瑜瑜拿它和最初測試的直木板比較。

pages.title: Check each joint
lines: One model joint slips when they lift the bridge. Gail points it out, and the builder helps connect the pieces before another test.
pages.translation: 他們抬起模型時，一處接點滑開了。瑜瑜指出問題，工匠幫忙把兩塊連好才再測試。

pages.title: Choose a plan
lines: The builders plan a correctly sized platform with sturdy supports and secure joints. Gail uses the model to show which measurements they checked.
pages.translation: 工匠計畫使用尺寸正確的橋面、穩固支柱與牢靠接點。瑜瑜用模型指出他們核對過的測量結果。

pages.title: Bring the right plank
lines: The adults bring a plank of the measured length to the bridge site. It spans both supports while Gail watches from the safe area.
pages.translation: 大人把依量測長度準備的木板送到橋邊。它跨到兩側支座，瑜瑜在安全區觀看。

pages.title: Build the platform
lines: Adult builders fasten the platform and its bolts, then check each joint. The children remain behind the marked work line during construction.
pages.translation: 成年工匠固定橋面與螺栓，再檢查每個接點。施工時孩子們始終留在標示的工作線後。

pages.title: Test it first
lines: Before inviting anyone across, the builder checks that the bridge is level and tests its support. The finished platform stays steady under his steps.
pages.translation: 工匠邀請其他人過橋前，先檢查橋面是否平整並測試支撐。他走上去時，完工橋面保持穩固。

pages.title: Walk across
lines: After the builder says the bridge is ready, Gail walks across with an adult. She can see the stream safely flowing beneath the new platform.
pages.translation: 工匠確認橋已可通行後，瑜瑜才和大人一起走過。她看見溪水安全地從新橋面下方流過。

pages.title: The ruler glows
lines: The builder thanks Gail for helping compare the lengths and test the model. The folding ruler glows and opens the route back to her bedroom.
pages.translation: 工匠謝謝瑜瑜協助比較長度、測試模型。折疊尺發光，打開回臥室的路。

pages.title: Back in the bedroom
lines: Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail folds the ruler and sets it beside her bed. She remembers to measure, make a model, and revise a plan before building.
pages.translation: 回到熟悉臥室，瑜瑜把尺折好放在床邊。她記得搭建前先測量、做模型，並修正計畫。
